slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: A continental report of the October 2016 APAI-CRVS monitoring round; its tables give counts of countries only, and Niger appears solely in the annex of composite scores, placed below 35 per cent on digitization of the civil registration system. It does not say which answer Niger gave on electronic recording at local offices, and names no system.
